title: Monorepo, build tooling and lockfile baseline

acceptance_gates.description: Repository structure, workspace definitions and pinned language runtimes are present and verified by an automated structure gate.
Python and Node dependency resolution is lockfile-driven and reproducible; CI installs from the committed lockfiles rather than ad-hoc version pins.
Format, lint and typecheck run in CI ahead of unit tests, per the v1.2 CI gate order.
